loadout.hint:
Record: equip 12 sigils on the character, open Inventory > Sigils filtered by character, record the first row, then move focus down to row 12.
Write: similarly, equip 12 unused sigils and write from row 1 through 12.
Notes: do not equip two or more identical sigils, and do not scroll too quickly. Complete `gbfr-loadout` files and GBFR Logs snapshots retain draft data for weapons, skills, summons, masteries, over limits, and more; this module currently writes only sigils.
